summary: Frontend testing completed for 4 bug fixes. All 4 features are working correctly: 1) Milk price saving in System Settings, 2) Refresh button in HR Attendance report, 3) 5 camera slots in CCTV page, 4) Appearance tab in Settings page with theme options.

feature_1_milk_price_saving.details: System Settings page loads with 4 tabs (المراكز, الأسعار, الأعلاف, التنبيهات). Prices tab shows Camel milk (حليب الإبل) and Cow milk (حليب الأبقار) cards. Edit price dialog opens with price input. Save button calls POST /api/settings/milk-prices and shows success toast 'تم حفظ السعر بنجاح'. Price updates correctly from 0.300 to 0.400.

feature_2_hr_attendance_refresh.details: HR page loads with 14 tabs. Attendance tab (الحضور) is visible and clickable. Refresh button found with data-testid='refresh-attendance-btn'. Button is clickable and triggers attendance data refresh. Attendance report shows employee records with date, name, check-in time, and source.

feature_3_cctv_5_camera_slots.details: CCTV page loads with data-testid='cctv-system'. All 5 camera slots found with data-testid='camera-slot-1' through 'camera-slot-5'. Each slot shows 'خانة فارغة' (empty slot) with 'إضافة كاميرا' (Add camera) button. Grid layout displays 5 slots in responsive columns.

feature_4_settings_appearance_tab.details: Settings page loads with 5 tabs (إعدادات الحساب, تغيير كلمة المرور, المظهر, مراكز التجميع, سجل النشاط). Appearance tab (المظهر) is visible and clickable. Shows 8 theme options: الافتراضي, المحيط, الغروب, الغابة, ملكي, الورد, منتصف الليل, الذهبي. Dark mode toggle (الوضع الليلي) present. Button preview section shows primary, secondary, and ghost buttons.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 bug fixes verified working: 1) Milk price saving uses POST /api/settings/milk-prices endpoint, 2) HR attendance refresh button has data-testid='refresh-attendance-btn', 3) CCTV page has 5 camera slots with data-testid='camera-slot-{1-5}', 4) Settings page has Appearance tab with 8 themes and dark mode toggle. No mocked APIs.
